blurb: Guests can embark on tailored fishing and wildlife escapes including inshore, shallow water, offshore, middle grounds fishing, airboat tours, scalloping adventures, and duck hunting. The captain specializes in targeting shallow water species in grass flats and back country creeks. Offshore trips use a 42 Freeman boat equipped with Simrad Electronics to find fish in Gulf of Mexico hot spots.
